summary: Verified 'Plan vs Actual Chart Polish' feature for Study Planner: (1) Study Plan Wizard Step-3 'Next 14 days' bar tooltip shows per-day total + per-session title & varied minutes (34m/15m/16m — not static) on hover, and is absent on rest bars; (2) Dashboard PlanTodayCard 'Upcoming this week' now shows REAL session/project titles (regression bug fix verified — no more generic 'Session' label); (3) PlanTrendChart renders on committed plan and its custom PlanTooltip shows date + Planned/Actual hours on hover. Backend endpoints (POST /preview, POST /commit, GET /dashboard-summary, DELETE /active) all return 200 with correct shapes.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanTrendChart empty-state condition ('Trend chart starts tomorrow') was NOT hit in this test even on day 1 — the chart rendered a single data point instead. The review-request note said this empty state was expected on day 1; if intended, verify the threshold logic in PlanTrendChart matches the product spec (should show empty when history <= 1 point).

Trend tooltip's 'That day's sessions' subsection could not be visually verified because day 1 was a rest day (no items). Would need a backdated day with items or a second-day-after commit to visually verify the per-item breakdown on the LineChart. Backend was verified separately to return items in cumulative.days_so_far[].items with real titles+minutes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard bar tooltips use CSS group-hover (opacity-0 -> group-hover:opacity-100), so tooltip DOM element exists but is invisible until hovered — use element.hover() and check computed opacity. Backend preview response uses `target_mode`, `target_hours_per_day`, `non_study_weekdays` (NOT `mode`/`hours_per_day`/`rest_days`). PlanTrendChart tooltip is a custom PlanTooltip inside recharts LineChart. To fully verify 'That day's sessions' section of the trend tooltip, the plan must have at least one non-rest day already in days_so_far (day 1 of a fresh plan on a weekend won't have items).

verification_evidence.upcoming_rows_regression_fix: 5 upcoming rows all show real descriptive titles: 'What Is Finance, Really?', 'Economics for Analysts — The Forces Behind the Numbers', 'Decode a Company\'s DNA', 'The Primary Market — How Companies Raise Money', 'Trace a Share\'s Journey' with real minutes (110m, 15m, 360m, 90m, 360m).
